comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Lake Victoria is more than just a beautiful body of water. Millions of people depend on it for food, work, and their daily survival. I’d love to see more about the lives of the fishing communities and how they protect this incredible resource for future generations.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Our documentary dives into exactly that, showing how entire towns of fishing families share the lake and work together to sustain their communities! 🌍
